brief: Inspect Camden Works 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-781) and clear any encroaching vegetation maintaining a minimum clearance of two metres between any growth and the radiator face, and one metre between growth and the compound fence line, as specified in SOP-011. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021. Record the sample reference, the result, and the resulting action against the asset, treating an open sampling defect as an outstanding remedial item for the purposes of pre-event triage pursuant to SOP-013.
